description: Shared contract fixture corpus. Consumed by backend tests (Python), agent tests (Go), and frontend mocks (TypeScript). One corpus, three consumers - see contracts/ids.md and ADR-003 D-3.9.

cases.rule: Canonical batch: workload->Service, workload->StatefulSet, workload->EXTERNAL.
Single edge, no byte fields. Bytes absent is the Phase 0-3 normal case.
Byte fields populated. Only valid after the Phase 4 feasibility gate; the schema allows it earlier.
Unsupported schema_version is a VERSION problem -> 400, deliberately not 422.
batch_id must be 26-char Crockford base32; it is the idempotency key.
25 characters. Length is checked before the pattern.
ReplicaSet is NOT an allowed kind: pods collapse through it to the Deployment.
Arbitrary kinds are rejected at the API and again by the DB CHECK constraint.
UDP is out of scope for this release (ADR-001 s4.2).
Timezone-naive datetime. All timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC and aware.
connection_count >= 1. An edge with no connections is not an edge.
Negative counts would corrupt the bucket sum on upsert.
Port range is 1-65535.
Port range is 1-65535.
Byte counters are non-negative when present.
last_seen must not precede first_seen.
extra=forbid. Source port is deliberately not part of the contract (it is ephemeral).
cluster_id is required; it is embedded in every canonical node ID.
agent_id must be non-empty for delivery diagnostics.
Aggregation interval must be >= 1 second.
